A word of welcome

We’re so glad you’re here

Hello and welcome to Redeemed People’s Mission Inc. My name is N. C. Thompson.

If this is your first time here, we’d like you to know how excited we are to have you.

Allow me to thank our heavenly Father for His goodness and mercies, through which we remain alive and fellowship together.

At RPM, all visitors are welcome to be a part of our family. We thank you for joining us, and we want you to be comfortable as you receive what God has in store for you.

Here, you will find messages that are aimed at transforming your life for the better.

On this website, you can find more information about our service time, upcoming events, location, and membership. If you wish to also give to the ministry, you can find the link button to do so.

You may wish to let us know a little bit more about you and how we can serve and pray for you. Please, always feel free to contact us.

For His Kingdom,
Rev. & Dr. (Mrs.) Thompson

About us

Our story, our vision and what we hold dear.

Our story

Obedience that bore fruit

Redeemed People’s Mission Inc. is a church with its headquarters in Jos, Plateau State, Nigeria, and a vision of reaching the whole world with the whole Word of God. What began as a simple act of faith to carry the gospel to northern Nigeria has grown steadily through obedience to that vision.

The General Superintendent, Rev. N.C. Thompson, stepped into an unknown project in answer to God’s call, trusting the words of Jesus: “Except a corn of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it abideth alone” (John 12:24).

  1. A Bible study groupMeeting twice a week at different locations.
  2. A garri shed in Katako Laranto, JosThe place where Redeemed People’s Mission was born.
  3. 29th May 1977Separation from FGS.
  4. 5th June 1977The Mission formally begins as Redeemed People’s Mission.
  5. TodayNine districts and a national headquarters church, each with several churches under it.
Our vision

To grow a global church through practical demonstration of the Word and power of God to make everyone complete in Christ.

Our mission

To communicate God’s Word in the power of the Holy Spirit to the world through Church Ministry, Educational Institutions, Media and Cross-Cultural Missions.

Lives touched and transformed, delivered from darkness into the light of the Son of God.BORN OF GOD AND OVERCOMETH THE WORLD · 1 JOHN 5:4
What we value

Our core beliefs

E

Excellence

God is excellent in His nature. We strive to serve above mediocrity in all our endeavours.

I

Integrity

We are the letters of God written unto all the people (2 Cor. 3:3). Therefore, we will conduct all our affairs both in public and private in all honesty and truthfulness so that the name of Jesus will not be reproached.

D

Diversity

People from different ethnic, cultural and social backgrounds receive a warm welcome and are encouraged to contribute their quota in service to God and humanity.

What we believe

Our Articles of Faith

The Redeemed People’s Mission shall believe, hold and teach the following as her fundamental Christian doctrines:

1

The Bible

That the Bible is the infallible, indispensable and inspired Word of God and therefore the Final Authority in all matters of doctrines.

2

The Trinity

That there are three persons in one God, viz: the Father, the Son (Jesus Christ) and the Holy Spirit.

3

The Church

That the Church of Christ is made up of all (dead and alive) who have received Christ by faith as their personal Saviour, Christ Himself being the Head.

Ministries

There’s a place for you to belong and to serve.

01

Men’s Fellowship

A community where men grow in faith, support one another, and learn to lead their homes and communities with integrity.

02

Sisters’ Fellowship

A place for women to pray, encourage one another and grow in the Word, and to serve the church and community together.

03

Youth Fellowship

A lively community for young people to discover their purpose in Christ, build good friendships and develop their gifts.

04

Children Ministry

A safe and joyful place where children learn about Jesus through Bible stories, songs and activities.

05

Worship Team

Singers and musicians who lead the congregation into God’s presence through praise and worship.

06

Ushering

The welcoming team who greet visitors, help people find a seat, and keep services running smoothly and in order.

07

Security Team

Volunteers who keep the church premises safe and secure so that everyone can worship in peace.
